FILTER · a letter picks a field · j/k and Enter · Esc back
filter: none
> s  state     todo, doing, depends, done, dropped
  t  type      feature, bug, chore, spike, docs
  p  priority  critical, high, medium, low
  g  group     a group, or (root)
  l  label     one label
  a  assignee  a person or agent, or (unassigned)
  e  epic      an epic's children
--
SORT · a letter adds a field (then by), again flips it · ⌫ last · Enter applies · Esc keeps the order
sort: rank
  c  current column mark one with H/L first
  p  priority  critical first
  t  type      feature, bug, chore, spike, docs
  s  state     todo, doing, depends, done, dropped
  u  updated   newest first
  d  created   date created, newest first
  g  group     a to z
  a  assignee  a to z, unassigned last
  n  title     a to z
